destinationsHealth.title: Destination Health Center
destinationsHealth.intro: Credential and OAuth expiry, API versions, rate limits, error rate, queue backlog and the last successful delivery of every destination — measured from real delivery attempts. Diagnose or pause one destination without stopping ingestion or the others.
destinationsHealth.editHint: Opens the setup wizard of this destination.
destinationsHealth.noSitesText: Create a site first — destinations belong to a site.
destinationsHealth.emptyText: Add an ad platform, analytics tool, affiliate network or webhook. Health is measured from real delivery attempts, never estimated.

attention.title: Needs attention first
attention.none: No open issue in the measured data.

table.caption: Destinations with their measured health, credentials, deliveries and queue backlog

oauth.title: OAuth connection
oauth.refreshHint: Access tokens are refreshed automatically from the stored refresh token.

deliveries.title: Deliveries (last {hours} h)

deliveries.errorRateNone: Error rate not measurable without attempts

queue.notMeasuredHint: The worker's destination-health job has not reported for this destination.

freshness.missingText: The worker's destination-health job has not written a snapshot for {count} destinations. Delivery counts, credentials and API versions on this page are live; queue figures appear once the job has run.
freshness.staleText: The latest worker snapshot is from {when}. Delivery counts, credentials and API versions are live.

issues.credential_expired: A credential has expired — the vendor will reject deliveries.
issues.auth_failures: The vendor rejected the credentials on {count} attempts.
issues.status_error: The destination is in error state.
issues.health_degraded: The last health check reported a degraded service.
issues.dead_letters: {count} events could not be delivered and were dead-lettered.
issues.not_connected: The destination is not connected; nothing is delivered.
issues.paused: Paused {when}; events for this destination are skipped.
issues.draft: Setup not finished — open the wizard.

reasons.vendor_timeout: Vendor did not answer in time
reasons.destination_missing: Destination no longer in the published configuration

failures.title: Recent failures (7 days)
failures.none: No failed attempts in the last 7 days.

actions.diagnoseHint: Runs the connector's credential validation and health check with the stored secrets and records the result.
actions.pauseText: Events keep being collected and delivered to every other destination. Events for this destination are skipped while it is paused — they are not queued for later. You can resume at any time.
actions.resumeText: Track runs a credential check first. Deliveries resume only if the vendor accepts the stored credentials; otherwise the destination stays disconnected and the reason is shown here.
actions.readOnly: Your role can view this page; diagnosing, pausing and resuming needs the integrations permission.

results.notResumed: Not resumed — the vendor did not accept the credentials.
results.paused: Paused. Events for this destination are skipped.

error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.invalid: This action is not possible in the destination's current state.
error.connector_unavailable: This connector is not available on this platform.
error.vault_missing: Credential storage is not configured; stored secrets cannot be read.
error.timeout: The vendor did not answer within 25 seconds.
error.failed: The check could not be completed.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
